contract.visualAnchor: Original Left 4 Dead Witch: hunched human infected with long unkempt hair, pale damaged skin, very long claw-like fingernails, bare feet and torn civilian clothing, seated and crying before provocation. Not a bride, a daytime wandering sequel variant or a spell-casting witch.

sourceRoleContract.sourceBody: Original seated and crying Witch
sourceRoleContract.sourceGameplayBoundary: Startling triggers pursuit and claw attacks. Witch is an infected human title, not evidence for sorcery or a ranged scream projectile.
